A '''cantina''' existed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and a contingent of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in search of the criminal [[Attuma Duum]]. Several of Duum's operatives arrived, however, and a [[lightfight]] ensued. Everyone in the cantina save for Secura [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="JA" />
